units.description: Unit of every coordinate, width and radius: grid squares, or scene pixels.

darknessLock.description: Lock the darkness so time of day does not change it.

globalLight.description: Foundry's global illumination, lighting the whole scene.

globalLightDarkness.description: The darkness range global light shines in: the day; none where a region leaves it darker (a roofed room).

fog.description: Fog of war exploration: disabled, individual (each user their own), or shared.

fogColours.description: The fog's colours over explored and unexplored ground.

cycle.description: Whether the lighting moves from the base environment to the dark one as darkness rises.

hue.description: 0–1, a fraction of the colour wheel.

intensity.description: How strongly the hue tints the scene, 0–1.

dark.description: The lighting environment at full darkness.

intensity.description: How strongly the hue tints the scene, 0–1.

weather.description: A Foundry weather effect key (CONFIG.weatherEffects), or "" for none.

transition.description: The transition shown on entering the scene.

type.description: A Foundry scene transition type, or null for none.

scene.description: The scene's own settings, as its config's Basics, Lighting and Ambience tabs set them; only those given change.

levels.description: Levels to add, bottom to top, stacked above any the scene has; with one taking the scene's own floor, those before it go below.

existing.description: Take the scene's lowest level as this one (renamed to `name`) instead of adding a level: a fresh scene's own floor becomes the ground floor, so the scene opens on it. At most one level does; levels listed before it are added below it (cellars), those after above. A scene with no levels adds it.

bottom.description: Floor elevation (scene distance units); with `top`, sets the band.

background.description: Image Foundry draws as this level's background, for this floor alone.

foreground.description: Image Foundry draws over this level's tokens (roofs, canopies).

fog.description: Image shown in unexplored fog on this level.

backgroundColor.description: Colour shown where the level has no background image.

tints.description: The background's and foreground's tints (Foundry's fog image has none since 14.364).

alphaThresholds.description: Image pixels less opaque than this let light and weather through (Foundry's Alpha Threshold).

placement.description: Where the level's images sit (Foundry's Positioning).

visibleLevels.description: Keys of the other levels seen from this one.

splats.description: Painted texture blends. A level stacks up to four, bottom to top in the order listed, for sixteen textures.

level.description: Key of an entry in `levels`. Omitted: the feature shows on every level.

mask.description: Path to the mask image: an 8-bit RGBA or RGB PNG laid over the whole scene, each channel weighting one texture (RGB leaves the fourth unused).

roles.description: The texture roles of the red, green, blue and alpha channels, e.g. "sand"; null for a channel not used.

items.description: A level's painted texture blend (its splat map), as the paint tool's Blend brush makes one.

key.description: A name other entries use for this feature, as a light switch's `controls` do.

texture.description: A texture role from the active set to draw the ground in instead of its biome's (`floor.cobbled-street`, another biome's), which still says what the ground is. A role the set lacks draws as the biome.

sharp.description: Its exact outline with a crisp edge (a deck, a paved yard, storm doors), instead of smoothed and feathered.

movementCost.description: Difficult ground: what crossing it on foot costs, times the distance (1 ordinary, 2 mud), as Foundry's Modify Movement Cost.

reads.description: What players read on it by hovering over it: a sign's words, a plaque's inscription.

mirror.description: Drawn flipped left to right, before its rotation (the far end of a counter).

inert.description: Drawn only, with none of its behaviour (walls, lights, doors, a way between levels): another placement carries that (a flight's steps seen again from the floor above).
